name: RC-B10-0121/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election situation in Uganda and threats against opposition leader Bobi Wine
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Uganda's January 2026 elections, which it says were marred by fraud, violence and an internet shutdown. It condemns the crackdown on opposition leader Bobi Wine, his family and supporters, and on civil society and journalists. It asks Uganda to release people held arbitrarily, stop military trials of civilians and reform its electoral system. It also asks the European Union to review its support for Uganda and consider targeted sanctions.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally. Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** Uganda's government and opposition, plus European Union cooperation and aid to Uganda.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union bodies, the African Union and Uganda's authorities.
